subject: POC re-baseline: additional use cases & updated success criteria
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@finerahealth.com>; Michael Torres <m.torres@finerahealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: POC re-baseline: additional use cases & updated success criteria

Thanks again for the time today — this thread captures the agreed re-baseline items from our call and proposed next steps so we all have the same frame. Please reply with any corrections.

Recap (what we covered)
- Goal: validate Redwood Inference for Finera’s two priority flows (customer support triage + real-time invoice parsing) under production-like throughput.
- Original POC scope: support triage only (30k messages / day peak, 99th pct latency target ~300ms).
- Request today: add the invoice parsing use case (structured extraction + field-level accuracy checks).

Proposed changes to scope (what Marissa / Redwood proposes)
- Add Use Case B: invoice parsing. Acceptance criteria for Use Case B: 
  - Field extraction F1 score >= 0.92 on our sample of 500 invoices
  - End-to-end latency <= 800ms for single-document parse (95th pct)
  - Batch throughput: 100 docs / minute sustained across 10-minute window
- Keep Use Case A (support triage) criteria as previously: intent classification accuracy >= 0.88 and 95th pct latency <= 300ms.
- New consolidated success criteria: both A and B must meet thresholds for POC to be "Successful".

Timeline (proposed)
- 2026-03-01: updated acceptance matrix and test data delivered (we attached the matrix).
- 2026-03-03 => 2026-03-17: extended trial window (2-week execution window) to accommodate invoice tests.
- 2026-03-18: joint results review and go/no-go decision.

Owners
- Redwood: Marissa Cole (POC lead), Rohan Mehta (infra/ops contact), Grace O'Connor (CS/enablement).
- Finera: Alyssa Chen (product owner), Michael Torres (integration lead).

Attachments
- [Attachment: poc-acceptance-matrix.xlsx (xlsx)] (will include test sets + pass/fail checklist).

Next steps
1) Finera to confirm acceptance of new criteria and the 2-week extension by EOD 24-Feb.
2) Redwood to send revised SOW and updated test data.
3) Schedule kickoff for the expanded POC (Mar 3 preferred).

Thanks — let me know if you'd like a short 15-min sync tomorrow to walk the matrix.

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: POC re-baseline: additional use cases & updated success criteria

Marissa — thanks for the clear summary. We agree in principle but two items to call out: 

1) We definitely want the invoice parsing use case added. The key business metric for us is field-level precision on vendor name, invoice_number, total_amount and tax. We can supply a labeled set of ~600 invoices but would like Redwood to validate on those plus the 500 you mentioned.

2) We will need a 2-week extension to run both functional and integration tests with our ingestion pipeline (we estimate +2 weeks). Can you confirm there is no material pricing impact for the extended window?

If you can get the revised acceptance matrix and SOW over to us, we can confirm formally by EOD Thursday 26-Feb.

Also, please include a short note on how you’ll measure "field-level F1" (micro/macro) — we prefer micro-average.

Thanks,
Alyssa Chen
Senior Product Manager — Data Workflows
Finera Health

Quick note from the GTM side: adding the invoice parsing use case and the +2 week extension is fine, but we should flag the potential pricing delta up front so there are no surprises. I've created a revised SOW draft and attached it here for discussion. If Finera signs the updated SOW we can commit the reserved slot with Rohan's team.

[Attachment: revised-sow.pdf (pdf)]

Thanks team — I reviewed the revised SOW and acceptance criteria. Approve moving forward with the scope change and the 2-week extension. A few operational notes: 

- Rohan, please reserve the infra slot for Finera for Mar 3–17 and confirm if we need to increase worker capacity for invoice parsing. If so, include the expected incremental GPU-hours estimate in the ticket.
- Grace, please prepare a 30-min onboarding plan for Alyssa & Michael covering evaluation tooling, test harness access, and how we’ll collect sample metrics (we should instrument micro F1 as "micro-average").
- Jordan, please include the $4,200 estimate in the SOW and get Alyssa sign-off (email OK).

We should avoid changing acceptance criteria mid-run unless both sides agree in writing; that said I’m comfortable with the criteria Marissa proposed. Keep me posted if Finera requests any further substantive changes.

—Vivek
